name: ToggleGroup
description: Selects among two to five options in a segmented control with a visible active choice.

value.description: Chosen value (controlled): a string, or a string array with multiple

defaultValue.description: Initial value (uncontrolled): a string, or a string array with multiple

onValueChange.description: Called with the next value: (value: string) => void, or (value: string[]) => void with multiple. A chosen segment stays chosen when pressed again in single mode.

multiple.description: Let several options stay pressed; the value becomes a string array

size.description: Size on the one track: xs 24, sm 28, md 32, lg 40. Defaults to the nearest ComponentDefaultsProvider controlSize.

fullWidth.description: Stretch the track to its container; segments share the width

when: Switching between mutually exclusive views or modes
Choosing one of two to five options
View switchers, segmented filters and the colour-mode control
A short row of formatting toggles (multiple)
whenNot: More than five options — use Select or RadioGroup
Moving between pages or panels — use Tabs
A single on/off — use Switch or a toggle IconButton
A form field the user submits — use RadioGroup or a Checkbox group
guidelines: Labels short enough to scan in one pass
Icons work for well-known modes like grid and list; an icon beside a label is fine
One look: the band track with the chosen segment on the lifted thumb
Name the group with aria-label or aria-labelledby
The colour-mode control is a composition: a ToggleGroup wired to useTheme, System first
accessibility: The group has role group; each item is a toggle button with aria-pressed
Arrow keys move between items, Tab enters and leaves the group
Icon-only items still need an aria-label
Focus is drawn by the shared focus ring on top of its neighbours

examples.name: Default
examples.description: One option at a time on the band track.
examples.code:
<ToggleGroup aria-label="Alignment" value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="left">Left</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="center">Center</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="right">Right</ToggleGroup.Item>
</ToggleGroup>

examples.name: Uncontrolled
examples.description: defaultValue when nothing outside needs the selection.

examples.name: Multiple
examples.description: Several toggles may stay pressed; the value is a string array.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: xs in dense inspectors, lg where the control anchors a page.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack gap="md" align="start">
  <ToggleGroup aria-label="Extra small" size="xs" defaultValue="a">
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="a">Day</ToggleGroup.Item>
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="b">Week</ToggleGroup.Item>
  </ToggleGroup>
  <ToggleGroup aria-label="Small" size="sm" defaultValue="a">
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="a">Day</ToggleGroup.Item>
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="b">Week</ToggleGroup.Item>
  </ToggleGroup>
  <ToggleGroup aria-label="Large" size="lg" defaultValue="a">
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="a">Day</ToggleGroup.Item>
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="b">Week</ToggleGroup.Item>
  </ToggleGroup>
</Stack>

examples.name: View Switcher
examples.description: Icon-only modes, each named for screen readers.
examples.code:
import { List, SquaresFour } from '@phosphor-icons/react';

<ToggleGroup aria-label="View" value={view} onValueChange={setView} size="sm">
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="grid" aria-label="Grid view">
    <SquaresFour aria-hidden />
  </ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="list" aria-label="List view">
    <List aria-hidden />
  </ToggleGroup.Item>
</ToggleGroup>

examples.name: Colour Mode
examples.description: The colour-mode control: a ToggleGroup wired to useTheme, System first.

examples.name: Full Width
examples.description: The track fills its container and the segments share it.

examples.name: Disabled Item
examples.description: One option locked out; the rest stay reachable.
examples.code:
<ToggleGroup aria-label="Tier" value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="basic">Basic</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="pro">Pro</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="enterprise" disabled>Enterprise</ToggleGroup.Item>
</ToggleGroup>

relations.note: The colour-mode control is a ToggleGroup wired to useTheme

propsSummary: value?: string | string[] - chosen value (string[] with multiple)
onValueChange?: (value: string) => void, or (value: string[]) => void with multiple
multiple?: boolean - several options may stay pressed
size: xs|sm|md|lg - size on the one track
fullWidth?: boolean - segments share the container width
